description: Org-scoped operator surface. Provides visibility and admin actions strictly within a single organization. Cannot access system-level controls, cross-org data, or evaluate policy directly.
nonNegotiableRules: All API routes must call requireOrgScope() before processing
Cross-org requests must be blocked at the API layer
All mutations must be routed through getOrgScopedCpClient()
No direct DB calls from Platform Admin routes
No local policy evaluation — proxy to Control Plane
